mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls above 200k signals stronger employment growth, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 200k for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of above-200k payroll growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly decline in real GDP growth below 1% signals weakening demand, which reduces corporate earnings and increases recession risk, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 1% for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sub-1% GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-month contraction in industrial production below 99.5 signals supply-side weakness, which raises input costs and reduces margins, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sub-99.5 INDPRO (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in CPI above 3% signals persistent inflation, prompting tighter monetary policy and higher discount rates, which reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL growth > 3% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of above-3% CPI growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4% signals labor market overheating, which increases wage pressures and inflation risk, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sub-4% unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-month decline in the Housing Starts Index below 1,300 signals weakening residential demand, which reduces construction spending and drags on equities, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of sub-1,300 HOUST (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A two-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls above 200k combined with a two-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4% signals labor market overheating, which increases wage pressures and inflation risk, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 200k for two consecutive months AND UNRATE < 4% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of above-200k payroll growth and sub-4% unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).
